newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Royce Labs estimates cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Royce Labs estimates cut.

text.p: -- Gruntal & Co Wednesday cut its estimate for Royce Laboratories' fiscal 1996 earnings to $0.08 from $0.20 per share.
-- The move was prompted by Royce announcing it expects to break even or even post a small loss in the fourth quarter, Gruntal said.
-- Gruntal also reduced its estimate for Royce's fiscal 1997 earnings to $0.25 per share from $0.35.
-- Rocye Laboratories is an independent generic drug manufacturing company. Its stock was unchanged at 30-1/4.
